title: JAL-Turn: Joint Acoustic-Linguistic Modeling for Real-Time and Robust Turn-Taking Detection in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems
abstract: arXiv:2603.26515v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient and robust turn-taking detection remains a significant challenge in industrial-grade voice AI agents. Existing systems often rely on acoustic or linguistic cues alone, limiting accuracy and stability, whereas directly endowing large language models with full-duplex capability incurs heavy data and deployment costs that hinder real-time usage. We propose JAL-Turn, a lightweight speech-only turn-taking framework based on a joint acoustic-linguistic modeling paradigm, in which a cross-attention module adaptively fuses pre-trained acoustic and linguistic representations for low-latency hold or shift prediction. translated_title: JAL-Turn：面向全双工语音对话系统中实时且鲁棒轮次转换检测的声学-语言联合建模
translated_abstract: 在工业级语音AI智能体中，高效且鲁棒的轮次转换检测仍然是一项重大挑战。现有系统通常仅依赖声学或语言线索，限制了准确性与稳定性；而直接赋予大语言模型全双工能力则会带来沉重的数据与部署成本，阻碍实时应用。我们提出了JAL-Turn，一个基于声学-语言联合建模范式的轻量级纯语音轮次转换框架，其中跨注意力模块自适应地融合预训练的声学与语言表示，用于低延迟的保持或转换预测。通过共享冻结的ASR编码器，JAL-Turn使轮次转换预测能够与语音识别完全并行运行，几乎不引入额外的端到端延迟。此外，我们还引入了一个可扩展的流水线，能够从大规模真实世界对话语料库中自动推导出可靠的轮次转换标签。
tldr: JAL-Turn提出了一种轻量级的声学-语言联合建模框架，通过跨注意力模块融合预训练声学与语言表示并共享冻结的ASR编码器，使轮次转换预测与语音识别完全并行运行，几乎不增加延迟即可实现实时鲁棒的轮次转换检测。
en_tdlr: JAL-Turn proposes a lightweight joint acoustic-linguistic modeling framework that adaptively fuses pre-trained acoustic and linguistic representations via cross-attention and shares a frozen ASR encoder, enabling real-time and robust turn-taking detection that runs fully in parallel with speech recognition with almost no additional end-to-end latency.
